Factor I: Planning and Organising.name: Effective Intelligence
Factor I: Planning and Organising.description: Ability to find practical solutions to complex problems.

Factor I: Planning and Organising.name: Reasoning Ability
Factor I: Planning and Organising.description: Ability to grasp the essentials of a problem and arrive at logical conclusions.

Factor I: Planning and Organising.name: Organising Ability
Factor I: Planning and Organising.description: Ability to arrange resources in a systematic manner.

Factor I: Planning and Organising.name: Power of Expression
Factor I: Planning and Organising.description: Ability to put across one's ideas clearly and with ease.

Factor II: Social Adjustment.name: Social Adaptability
Factor II: Social Adjustment.description: Ability to adapt oneself to the social environment.

Factor II: Social Adjustment.name: Cooperation
Factor II: Social Adjustment.description: Ability to willingly work with others in a group.

Factor II: Social Adjustment.name: Sense of Responsibility
Factor II: Social Adjustment.description: Understanding one's duties and discharging them faithfully.

Factor III: Social Effectiveness.name: Initiative
Factor III: Social Effectiveness.description: Ability to originate an action and sustain it.

Factor III: Social Effectiveness.name: Self-Confidence
Factor III: Social Effectiveness.description: Faith in one's own abilities to meet stressful situations.

Factor III: Social Effectiveness.name: Speed of Decision
Factor III: Social Effectiveness.description: Ability to arrive at workable decisions quickly.

Factor III: Social Effectiveness.name: Ability to Influence the Group
Factor III: Social Effectiveness.description: Capacity to persuade others to achieve a common objective.

Factor IV: Dynamic.name: Liveliness
Factor IV: Dynamic.description: Capacity to remain buoyant and cheerful in adversity.

Factor IV: Dynamic.name: Determination
Factor IV: Dynamic.description: Sustained effort to achieve an objective in spite of obstacles.

Factor IV: Dynamic.name: Courage
Factor IV: Dynamic.description: Ability to take calculated risks willingly.

Factor IV: Dynamic.name: Stamina
Factor IV: Dynamic.description: Capacity to withstand prolonged physical and mental strain.
